content: Maado demmanaw Gibxe wodheysatanne paran ammaneteyisata ayye! Para gaareta darotethaaninne para asata minotethan ammaneteyisata ayye! Enti Isra7eele Geeshshaa xeellokona woyko Godaape maado koyokona.
Shin Goday cinca gidiya gisho gado yeddana; I odidaysa aggenna. Iita asaa bollanne iitabaa oothiya asaa maaddeyisata bolla dendana.
Gibxeti asepe attishin, xoosse gidokona; enta paratika ashope attishin, ayyaana gidokona. Goday hanqon ba qesiya denthiya wode maaddeysi dhubetana; maadeteysi kundana; enti ubbay issife dhayana.

Goday taako haysada yaagis: “Gaammoy woyko wodala gaammoy mehe oykidi daariya wode henthanchoti xeegetidi shiiqikoka, I enta waasuwas dagammenna; enta qaalas yayyenna. Hessadaka, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday Xiyoone zumanne iya zumata olanaw wodhana.
Kafoy aaleysada Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday Yerusalaame gechana, ashshana, naagana; iya bollara aalidi heemmana.
“Hinteno Isra7eele asaw, hinte makallidi ixida, iyako simmite.
He gallas nagari kumida hinte kushiyan birapenne worqafe oothida eeqata wora holana.
Asoorey asaba gidonna mashshan kundana; asaba gidonna mashshi enta maana. Enti mashsha sinthafe baqatana; enta na7atethati wolqan asas oothana.
Dagama gaason enta mino miixay laaletana; enta toora moconati dagammidi yeggi dhayana” yaagees, iya tamay Xiyoonen, iya coocey Yerusalaamen de7iya Goday.
